entities.summary: Seven, a notable figure in the history of United Kingdom, associated with Anglo-Saxon Settlement and Kingdoms (500–700). Preceded by Heptarchy Formation and Anglo-Saxon Migrations. Their legacy influenced Augustinian Mission 597 and Synod of Whitby 664.
